valuation.valuation_commentary: Valuation analysis indicates an extreme overvaluation verdict with weighted fair value of $120.17 (-30.28% vs current $172.35). Substantial dispersion exists across anchors: historical cash flow DCF anchors (unlevered $21.24, self-built $52.95, levered $59.52) show severe downward gaps (-69.28% DCF gap), while analyst consensus PT ($199.95) and forward discounted earnings ($140.08) partially reflect market growth expectations. Forward validation is STRETCHED; archetype shadow provides near-term support around $160, but fundamental forward earnings and revenue path checks failed. Ineligible anchors include peer P/E, comps (<2 usable metrics), and forecaster blend.

red_team.counter_thesis: 看多論點過度依賴短期技術與消息面情緒，嚴重忽視市場現價隱含 60% FCF CAGR 與 +14.3% 營收成長的極端預期；在 10 年期實質利率達 2.4% 及分析師共識預期營收衰退 -7.8% 的基本面衝突下，多頭估值支撐極度脆弱。
kill_conditions: IF 未來 2 季（180天）自由現金流（FCF）年化增速低於 30%（遠低於市場隱含的 60% 5Y CAGR） WITHIN 180 天 THEN 現價依賴高增長定價的估值擴張論點破滅
IF 單季營收增速落入分析師共識預期的衰退區間（營收年增率 < 0%，對比市場隱含需達 +14.3% CAGR）且 10 年期實質利率維持在 2.4% 以上高位 WITHIN 90 天 THEN 估值倍數將面臨強烈均值回歸殺估值
IF 宏觀市場頂部風險處於 Orange 警戒區（40.4）且全平台季度交易手續費營收季減逾 20% WITHIN 60 天 THEN 短期技術與消息面支撐的多頭共識全面瓦解
